consultation.metaTitle: Book an initial consultation — a 15-minute call — Fareed Quraishi
consultation.metaDescription: Request a 15-minute telephone consultation about life coaching: what you are looking for, how the coaching works, and whether it is a good fit.

intro.title: Let’s start with a short conversation.
intro.lede: A 15-minute telephone call, to meet and talk about what you are looking for.

form.title: Request a consultation
form.lede: Please share only what you are comfortable putting in an ordinary email.

email.label: Email
email.hint: Where I should reply with some times to talk.

interest.label: Which are you most interested in?
interest.hint: Pick the closest option. It is not a commitment, and you can change your mind.

unsure.label: I’m not sure yet
unsure.note: That is the usual place to start.

message.label: Is there anything you would like me to know before we speak?
message.hint: Optional. A sentence or two is plenty. No history, no diagnosis, and nothing you would rather say out loud.

consent.label: I have read and understand the scope of this work
consent.text: Coaching is personal development support. It is not psychotherapy, diagnosis, medical treatment, or crisis support, and it does not replace them. I agree that Fareed may reply to the email address I have given, and I understand that sending this request books no session, reserves no place, and takes no payment.

form.privacyNote: Please do not include medical, diagnostic, or psychiatric information. This form is not monitored for urgent or crisis support. If you need immediate help, contact a crisis line or emergency services.
form.success: Thank you — your request has reached me. Nothing has been scheduled or charged. I will reply personally within three business days at the address you gave, with some times for a 15-minute call, and I will say honestly whether I think the coaching is a good fit. If you do not hear back, check your spam folder and then email me directly.
form.noscript: This form needs JavaScript to send. If you would rather write directly — or the form does not work — email me at

steps.name: We speak for 15 minutes
steps.body: Then you decide whether to go ahead.
